pages.text: 十月的深圳，秋风轻轻吹。咘咘和爸爸妈妈一起来到公园，金黄的落叶像小蝴蝶一样飞舞。咘咘开心地说：“今天我们来寻宝！”
pages.text_en: In October in Shenzhen, a gentle autumn breeze blew. Bubu came to the park with Mummy and Daddy, and golden leaves fluttered like little butterflies. "Let's go on a treasure hunt today!" Bubu said happily.

pages.text: 咘咘蹲在草地上，认真地找呀找。她找到一片心形的黄叶子，举起来给妈妈看。妈妈笑着说：“这片叶子最像一颗小爱心。”
pages.text_en: Bubu crouched on the grass and searched carefully. She found a heart-shaped yellow leaf and held it up for Mummy to see. "This leaf looks just like a little heart," Mummy said with a smile.

pages.text: 一片红红的叶子挂在高高的树枝上。爸爸轻轻抱起咘咘，咘咘伸手一够，就把红叶子摘了下来。“谢谢爸爸！”咘咘开心地亲了爸爸一下。
pages.text_en: A bright red leaf hung on a high branch. Daddy lifted Bubu up gently, and Bubu reached out and picked the red leaf. "Thank you, Daddy!" Bubu said, giving Daddy a happy kiss.

pages.text: 妈妈铺开一张大纸，和咘咘一起把叶子拼呀拼。黄的、红的、橙的叶子，慢慢拼成了一只可爱的小兔子。咘咘拍着手说：“这就是我！”
pages.text_en: Mummy spread out a big sheet of paper, and together they arranged the leaves. Yellow, red and orange leaves slowly became a lovely little rabbit. "That is me!" Bubu clapped her hands.

pages.text: 咘咘挑出最漂亮的三片叶子，一片送给爸爸，一片送给妈妈，一片留给自己。爸爸妈妈把叶子夹进书里，说：“这是我们今天最珍贵的宝贝。”
pages.text_en: Bubu picked out the three prettiest leaves: one for Daddy, one for Mummy, and one for herself. Mummy and Daddy pressed the leaves into a book and said, "These are our most precious treasures today."

pages.text: 夕阳把公园染成了金色，咘咘抱着装满叶子的宝盒，和爸爸妈妈慢慢走回家。咘咘轻声说：“明天，我还要和你们一起寻宝。”
pages.text_en: The setting sun turned the park golden. Holding her box full of leaves, Bubu walked home slowly with Mummy and Daddy. "Tomorrow, I want to go treasure hunting with you again," Bubu whispered.
